## ⚠️ Use the "Submit to Task Bank" button instead

If you're here manually, please use the **"Submit to Task Bank"** button in your CI workflow's Job Summary instead. The button appears after your PR passes the Harbor Task Check.

---

If you must submit manually, fill in the table below **exactly** as shown:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Task ID** | `owner__repo-123` |
| **Source Repo** | [owner/repo](https://github.com/owner/repo) |
| **Source PR** | [#123](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123) |
| **Artifact** | [Download from CI](https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/XXXXXXX) |
| **Run ID** | `XXXXXXX` |
